summary: Josephine County lookout house on the Siskiyou NF, planned and built in 1929, staffed into the 1940s, abandoned in 1967 and since removed; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Removed, per Forest Lookouts (no date given); no source describes what remains at the site

notes_for_editor: Elevation conflict: firelookout.com gives 3,730 ft; Oregon Hikers and SummitPost give 3,975 ft for the summit. Treated as the same peak on the Illinois River Trail; the story gives both figures. The 1914 trail item, the 1931 fire, the 1932 death, the 1941 staffing and the 1943 filter-center note all come from Forest Lookouts' transcriptions of old newspaper items; no second source was read for them. Removal date not found. No source describes the site today. Not the Bald Mountain lookouts in Clackamas County (US 565) or Klamath County. Record elevation_m is null; leave for editor given the conflict. Distance conflict: the Grants Pass Daily Courier item of September 4, 1929 (quoted by Forest Lookouts) puts the lookout 58 miles from Grants Pass, while firelookout.com gives 29 miles west of Grants Pass; no source explains the difference, and the story reports both.
